metadata.name: RaiseTransactionDispute
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to raise the dispute for a Transaction. Dispute can be raised as Full or Partial.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Currency Code Ex. 840 = US Doller. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language ==  en: means use English ---- es: means Spanish Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Account number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Transaction Number for transaction being posted. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 23654789

request_fields.name: DisputeAction
request_fields.description: Action on Dispute Transaction. Valid Values: Please refer section 'Dispute Actions' of appendix sheet. Example: 0 - Initiate Dispute, 9 - Initiate Chargeback

request_fields.name: DisputeTxnAmount
request_fields.description: Disputed Transaction Amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX.XX Example: 10.00

request_fields.name: DisputeReason
request_fields.description: Reason through which Dispute resolution needs to take place. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 7 - Duplicate Processing

request_fields.name: MemoReason
request_fields.description: Reason of Memo Text. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: Disputed Transaction

request_fields.name: MemoText
request_fields.description: Text of the Memo. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: Disputed Transaction Posted

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Admin number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12345

request_fields.name: CaseID
request_fields.description: ID which is generated against the Dispute request. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:9856198 Condition: This is a required tag When DisputeAction=9.

request_fields.name: DocumentIndicator
request_fields.description: Indicator to confirm if customer have provided  document proofs or  not Valid Values: true/false

request_fields.name: ChargebackMemo
request_fields.description: Note which is to be sent to Association Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Example:Documents verified.

request_fields.name: ApplicantType
request_fields.description: Valid Values: Applicant/Co-Applicant/Cosigner Default Value: Applicant Selects the type of Applicants. Valid Values: 1, 2, 3 Format: x Example:  1= "Applicant", 2 ="Co-Applicant", 3= "Cosigner"

request_fields.description: Defines the Fraud Type Code prescribed for SAFE Reporting to Mastercard in the SAFE Reporting Guide. Valid Values:Refer Appendix Example: 06 Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: IdentifierToken
request_fields.description: A generated token that is not expired can be used as an input field to access API. If we are passing this field in input, user should not pass any other account identifier. Condition:At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 800

request_fields.name: RefundNotReceivedIndicator
request_fields.description: Indicator to send with Raise Chargeback API Valid Values: true/false

request_fields.name: IsBlockCard
request_fields.description: Indicator to Block the Card Valid Values: true/false

request_fields.name: FraudLabel
request_fields.description: Mark Transaction as Fruadulent/NonFraudulent. Valid Value: 0 and 1 Example: 1- Fraudulent 0- Non-Fraudulent Condition: Mandatory if the Feedzai system is active for that product but optional if the product is not enrolled in Feedzai.
